title: Supetar Travel Guide: Beaches, Ferries & Where to Stay
metaDescription: Plan your trip to Supetar, Brač. Discover the best areas to stay, driving routes from Europe, ferry details, parking options and local pebble beaches.
intro:
Supetar is the main entry point to the island of Brač and a practical base for travelers arriving by car from mainland Europe. It offers a functional mix of supermarkets, ferry connections, and services, combined with an active waterfront and accessible pebble beaches. The town suits families and road-trippers who want island life without the logistical complexity of reaching more remote destinations.

The summer months of July and August bring peak ferry traffic, warm sea temperatures, and fully operational restaurants along the harbor. May, June, and September provide quieter conditions and lower accommodation rates, though the sea is cooler for swimming. From October to April, many seasonal businesses close, but essential services and ferry links to Split remain active year-round.

areas.name: Supetar Centre (Harbour / Old Town)
areas.bestFor: Travelers without a car, short stays, and those who want restaurants nearby
areas.parking: Paid public lots near the ferry port; limited street parking
areas.beach: 10-15 minutes walking to Banj or Vlačica
areas.summary: The commercial and transport hub of the island. It features stone houses, cafes along the promenade, and immediate access to the Split car ferry.

areas.name: Tri Mosta & Bili Rat
areas.parking: Private hotel parking and large paid public lots near the beaches
areas.beach: Direct access to Tri Mosta (pebble) and Bili Rat
areas.summary: Located west of the center, this area holds most of Supetar's large hotels and resorts. It offers shaded pine forests, beach bars, and water sports facilities.

areas.name: Banj & Vlačica Area
areas.parking: Street parking can be tight; properties often provide spaces
areas.beach: Immediate access to Banj (sandy bottom) and Vlačica (pebble)
areas.summary: A residential neighborhood situated around two of the town's most popular bays. It provides a quieter atmosphere than the harbor while remaining a short walk from town facilities.

areas.name: Mirca
areas.bestFor: Travelers with a car seeking peace and quiet
areas.parking: Mostly free parking on private property
areas.beach: Uncrowded local pebble beaches within walking distance
areas.summary: A small village 3 kilometers west of Supetar. It features traditional stone houses, olive groves, and a much slower pace than the main town.

whenToGo: From June through September, Supetar is fully open with sea temperatures ranging from 23°C to 26°C. July and August bring the highest crowds, peak ferry queues, and premium accommodation prices, but guarantee all restaurants and beach facilities are operating. May and October offer mild weather and lower rates, though the sea is often too cold for swimming and some seasonal businesses close. From November to April, the town reverts to a quiet local rhythm; prices are at their lowest, but tourist infrastructure shuts down and the ferry runs on a reduced winter schedule.

faq.question: Is it worth visiting?
faq.answer: Yes, if you need a convenient, well-connected base on Brač. Supetar offers practical amenities, easy ferry access to Split, and pleasant family beaches, though it lacks the dramatic scenery of Bol.

faq.question: How many days do I need?
faq.answer: Three to five days is sufficient to explore Supetar and use it as a base for the rest of Brač. A shorter two-day stay works if you are only passing through to other island towns.

faq.question: What is the best beach?
faq.answer: Tri Mosta is widely considered the best beach for its clean pebbles, pine shade, and available facilities. Families with small children often prefer Banj beach due to its shallow sandy bottom.

faq.question: Do I need a car?
faq.answer: You do not need a car if you plan to stay in Supetar and just visit the local beaches. However, a car is highly recommended if you want to explore the rest of Brač, such as Vidova Gora or Zlatni Rat.

faq.question: Where can I park?
faq.answer: Large public paid parking lots are located near the ferry port and behind the Tri Mosta beach area. Street parking in the center is divided into paid zones, and spaces fill up quickly in July and August.

faq.question: Is it good for families?
faq.answer: Yes, Supetar is one of the most family-friendly destinations on Brač. It has shallow beaches with sandy patches, inflatable water parks, and flat seaside promenades suitable for strollers.
